sentence: This project uses CRISPR base-editing tools in primary human immune cells to find out what genetic variants do in genes linked to immune diseases.
This project offers study design and data analysis support to researchers studying pancreatic cancer, and adds bioinformatics and machine learning.
This project studies two pathways in Staphylococcus aureus and looks for compounds that may treat methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus infections.
This project combines information about the heart muscle and arteries before a heart procedure to improve treatment decisions for patients with coronary artery disease.
This project tests fusion-inhibitory peptides that block viral entry for Nipah, Hendra and human parainfluenza virus 3.
This project studies virus-specific T cells from vaccinated and challenged bats to learn how bats host viruses without disease.
This project tests how rare mutations linked to schizophrenia change edited human induced pluripotent stem cells and their signaling pathways.
This project uses eye imaging and artificial intelligence to build 3D maps of the eye drainage system and links its structure to eye pressure.
This project studies how a truncated form of a receptor causes pain at the site of oral cancer tumor development.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that estimate vocal tract gestures from audio to improve speech therapy for children with speech sound disorder.
This project studies the atomic structures of human cytomegalovirus to learn how the virus interacts with cells to cause viral spread.
This project studies whether a specialized type of immune cell in the liver helps cause primary biliary cholangitis, using patients and mouse models.
This project provides computational tools that model proteins and small molecules and screen virtually for drug hits.
This project develops a tool that uses existing chest CT data to screen older adults for frailty and tests how well it predicts death.
This project studies how the loss of chaperone-mediated autophagy changes T cells that carry clonal hematopoiesis mutations in aging.
This project develops a single-dose gene therapy that lowers the prion protein to treat prion disease, and builds the delivery vectors for it.
This project uses single molecule multimodal footprinting to study how chromatin organization changes over time during gene regulation in cardiac differentiation.
This project builds causal machine learning methods that combine large biomedical datasets to predict risk and improve treatment for patients with myeloid malignancies.
This project studies how reading comprehension in adolescents changes over time and looks for protective and risk factors for good and poor reading comprehension.
This project studies how parasitic nematodes and their bacterial endosymbiont partners interact at the molecular level.
